### Annual Report 2025

B. Braun continued its long-term growth path in fiscal year 2025. Group sales increase by 5.1
percent at constant currencies to € 9.4 billion.

][159]
[
[nurse talking with patient at the bedsite]

### More time for patient care.

Global staff shortages make health care professionals the most valuable resource in hospitals. Their
most limited asset is time. Discover solutions to help free up precious time.

][160]
[
[A healthcare professional is shown standing proudly with a sustainable-produced medical container.]

### New standards in sterile processing and operating room supply

A reliable and efficient supply of the OR is essential for creating daily and long-term success in
hospital processes. Digitally enhanced solutions to achieve clinical excellence.

][161]
[
[A medical laboratory employee is pouring liquid for a quality check.]

### Sustainability from the depths

With the expansion of its disinfectant production facility in Sempach, Switzerland, B. Braun is now
seizing the opportunity to set new standards in energy management.

][162]
[
[Digital microscope for neurosurgery named Aesculap Aeos® in front of a white background]

### A precise view of the future: New digital microscope technology for neurosurgery

New technology allows high-resolution views into the human body, making it a prerequisite for more
precise surgery.

# We are Committed to Life

[More][106]
[

### Vision

We strive to transform Fresenius Kabi in the decade to come. We are committed to increase
efficiencies in the therapy and care of patients and improve access to high-quality healthcare
around the globe.

[healthcare professionals in action]
][107]
[

### Excellence

We are specialized in lifesaving medicines and technologies for critically and chronically ill
patients. With our passion and expertise, we touch the lives of almost 450 million people every
year, each one representing the importance of our work.

[healthcare professionals in action]
][108]
[

### Sustainability

We constantly strive to improve our sustainability footprint. For us, meeting the needs of patients
and healthcare professionals goes hand in hand with responsible and ethical management.

[nurse taking hand of woman]
][109]
[

### Think Beyond: Latest Evidence for Effective Therapies in CKD

Join experts at the Global Renal Nutrition Webinar on June 16, 2026. Explore ERA 2026 insights,
protein‑reduced diets, and targeted CKD nutrition.
[Global Kidney Nutrition Webinar Key Visual]
][110]
[

### Women Who Shaped Us

At Fresenius Kabi, colleagues worldwide share personal stories for International Women’s Day,
honoring the women who shaped their courage and purpose.
[Images of Fresenius Kabi employees being interviewed on international womens day.]
][111]
[

### Fresenius Kabi recognized as a Top Employer in 13 countries

Fresenius Kabi has been certified by Top Employers Institute as a Top Employer for 2026 in 13
countries and additionally two regions.
[Image showing the top employer 2026 seals of the 13 countries and 2 regions.]
][112]
[

### Four Colleagues, Four Scientific Journeys: Voices of Women in Science

Female scientists from Biopharma, MedTech, Nutrition and Pharma share their stories and advice,
showing how science careers impact patient care and innovation.
[Image of women in science.]
][113]
[

### Meet The Heroes Behind Patient Safety

Unseen heroes ensure patient safety through precision, care, and smart tech at Fresenius Kabi.
Discover how people make the difference.
[Several people in different job roles like production and lab workers depicted as heroes with capes
and gadgets.]
][114]

# We’re tackling the world’s toughest health challenges

[ Medicines & therapies ][166]
Johnson & Johnson Innovative Medicine is leading where medicine is going. Patients inform and
inspire our science-based innovations, which continue to change and save lives. With rigorous
science and compassion, we confidently address the most complex diseases of our time and unlock the
medicines of tomorrow. Healthcare areas include: Oncology, Immunology, Neuroscience and
Cardiopulmonary.

[ Medical devices & technology ][172]
Johnson & Johnson MedTech innovates at the intersection of biology and technology. With a focus on
treating with pinpoint precision in the hardest-to-reach parts of the body, restoring anatomy and
reimagining healing, our portfolio of smarter, less invasive, more personalized treatments is
addressing the most complex health challenges. Healthcare areas include: Cardiovascular,
Orthopaedics, Surgery and Vision.

# Advancing Health Outcomes for All®

[ Discover McKesson ][125]

## Making Healthcare Happen

McKesson Corporation is a U.S.-based company with approximately 43,000 employees worldwide and
facilities across the U.S. and Canada. We serve as the logistical and operational backbone of the
U.S. healthcare system, helping ensure patients can access the therapies and care they need when and
where they need them.

Business Solutions
 

## Our Areas of Focus

Our services and technology ensure medicines reach every care setting, bring cancer and specialty
care close to home, and help patients break through access and affordability barriers.

We’re reimagining what’s possible by accelerating clinical trials, helping patients start and stay
on therapy, and building a stronger, smarter supply chain for the future.

[ Learn More ][126]

Strengthening Healthcare
 

## Powering Care Locally

For nearly two centuries, McKesson has strengthened the systems that move care forward by supporting
providers, enabling access to medicines and therapies, and removing barriers across the patient
journey.

    cancer and specialty care.

    provide lower-cost options for prescription medications and therapies.

# Advancing Health Outcomes for All®

[ Discover McKesson ][125]

## Making Healthcare Happen

McKesson Corporation is a U.S.-based company with approximately 43,000 employees worldwide and
facilities across the U.S. and Canada. We serve as the logistical and operational backbone of the
U.S. healthcare system, helping ensure patients can access the therapies and care they need when and
where they need them.

Business Solutions
 

## Our Areas of Focus

Our services and technology ensure medicines reach every care setting, bring cancer and specialty
care close to home, and help patients break through access and affordability barriers.

We’re reimagining what’s possible by accelerating clinical trials, helping patients start and stay
on therapy, and building a stronger, smarter supply chain for the future.

[ Learn More ][126]

### [ Consumer Products & Services ][132]

[Worker pulls pallet jack quickly through a warehouse aisle, shelves lined with boxes, motion blur

Strengthening Healthcare
 

## Powering Care Locally

For nearly two centuries, McKesson has strengthened the systems that move care forward by supporting
providers, enabling access to medicines and therapies, and removing barriers across the patient
journey.

Who we are

Engineering the 

extraordinary

# Groundbreaking healthcare technology solutions for the most complex and challenging conditions.
# Inspiring hope and new possibility in people all over the world.

[ See how ][175]

HEALTHCARE TECHNOLOGY

## Medtronic Engineering & Innovation Center (MEIC)

MEIC symbolizes Medtronic’s commitment to R&D and innovation in healthcare. It serves as a
technology hub to deliver on our mission.

[ Learn more ][176]

PUT PATIENTS FIRST

## See the signs, seize your destiny.

The #TimetoDecideDestiny campaign aims to create awareness about the importance of stroke prevention
and timely treatment by reaching the nearest stroke-ready hospital.

[ Learn more ][177]

PATIENT EQUITY

## Decode your rhythm

Learn about bradycardia and leadless pacemaker therapy. Explore causes, symptoms, and care tips.
#DecodeYourRhythm

[ Learn more ][178]

HealthCare Technology

## Medtronic Global Diabetes Capability Center

Engineering technology that simplifies diabetes care

[ Learn more ][179]

#### With 95,000-plus people in over 150 countries, we see extraordinary possibilities to further

complex and challenging conditions. Our careers change lives.

## We are Roche

We combine life-changing diagnostics and medicines to take on the toughest healthcare challenges,
those that place the greatest strain on patients, families, communities, and health systems. 

Guided by the experiences of patients, we are determined to prevent, stop and cure diseases so
people can live healthier, longer lives.

[Man holding a surfing board smiling with a ocean in the background.]

Our strategy

curative medicines.

Add-Tech Pty Ltd has been at the forefront of the medical industry since 1988. By working with both
public and private healthcare providers, our company has exposure to many different operating
structures and business models throughout the country. Our industry experience and our strong
customer focus has seen us grow into a renowned company within the healthcare sector. We provide for
clients throughout Australia and the Asia-Pacific. Our clients include:

* Government Hospitals
* Department of Defence
* Australian Federal Police
* Ambulance Services
* Private Hospitals
* Medical Centres
* Universities
* Veterinary Practices
* Physiotherapists
* Dental Facilities

# Uniting to Save and Sustain Lives

## Redefining Healthcare Delivery

We are everywhere healthcare happens – and everywhere it is going, with essential solutions in the
hospital, physician’s office and other sites of care. Every day, millions of patients and healthcare
providers rely on our unmatched portfolio of connected solutions, medical devices, and advanced
injectable technologies to help deliver smarter, more personalized care. Together, we are redefining
how care is delivered to make a greater impact today, tomorrow, and beyond.

[Nurse holding a mobile device]

## The future of healthcare is connected

Healthcare is at a turning point. Clinicians face growing workloads, while patients increasingly
expect seamless, coordinated experiences. Despite recent advances in technology, medical devices and
clinical systems continue to be isolated from each other, preventing effective data sharing,
creating inefficiencies and increasing the potential for gaps in care. The future demands better
connectivity.
* **100,000** nurses left the workforce during the COVID-19 pandemic
* **610,338** nurses reported intent to leave by 2027

[See how we’re connecting care][52]


[Patient pictured kneeling next to her Golden Retriever]
[Patient Story][53]

### From Pump to Pup: Finding Comfort in 'Baxter'

Izzy, a young cancer fighter and survivor, loves her dog, Baxter, named after the brand she saw on
the infusion pumps that delivered her chemotherapy.

[Read More][54]
[nurse smiling and standing next to a window ]
[Healthcare Insights][55]

### Technology and Service Support Chronic Disease Management at Home

Conditions such as hypertension, respiratory illnesses and cardiac issues can be monitored
effectively with innovative tools and connected devices.

[Read More][56]
[group event at a baseball game]
[People of Baxter][57]

### The Power of Teamwork to Support Patient Care

Teams bridged the pandemic and borders to bring an innovative ICU bed to life.

[Read More][58]
[Collage of images showing innovations in a manufacturing setting]
[Healthcare Insights][59]

### Supply Chain Innovation Delivers More Nimble, Efficient Solutions

Leaders from Baxter speak about our evolutions in manufacturing and supply chain processes as we
emerge from the COVID-19 pandemic

[Read More][60]
[Kim sitting at her desk smiling]
[People of Baxter][61]

### A Teacher at Heart

After losing her parents to heart disease, Kim resolved to share her knowledge about cardiac
monitoring with HCPs to identify potential issues early.

[Read More][62]
[Chabot graphic]
[Healthcare Insights][63]

### Dr. Chatbot Will See You Now

What role will AI play in healthcare in the future? We believe there are realistic opportunities for
AI to make healthcare more efficient and effective

[Read More][64]
[ Press Release ][65]

### Baxter Publishes 2025 Sustainability Report Highlighting Refreshed Strategy, Ongoing Commitment
### to Drive Meaningful Impact

[Read More][66]
[ Press Release ][67]

### Baxter Reports First-Quarter 2026 Results

[Read More][68]
[ Press Release ][69]

### Baxter Showcases Recent Innovations at AORN Global Surgical Conference and Expo 2026

[Read More][70]

## Our Commitment to Healthcare Professionals and Patients

We are committed to supporting patients and healthcare professionals with innovations that are
driven by compassion for their journeys, a passion to improve care and the ambition to transform the
future of healthcare.

[A doctor in a hospital room looks off to the side]

## Products for Healthcare Professionals

### Primary Care [ Primary Care Go to Primary Care ][71]

Supporting every aspect of your clinical practice, including physical exam, diagnostic cardiology,
vitals monitoring and vision screening

[ Go to Primary Care ][72]

### Hospital Care [ Hospital Care Go to Hospital Care ][73]

Advancing products and technologies designed to speed patient recovery and streamline clinical
workflows

[ Go to Hospital Care ][74]

### Surgical Care [ Surgical Care Go to Surgical Care ][75]

Delivering innovations that enable reduced operating times, faster patient recovery and improved
outcomes

[ Go to Surgical Care ][76]

### Nutritional Care [ Nutritional Care Go to Nutritional Care ][77]

Personalizing nutritional care designed to improve patients’ health in the hospital, the ICU and at
home

[ Go to Nutritional Care ][78]

### Respiratory Care [ Respiratory Care Go to Respiratory Care ][79]

Helping your patients with respiratory therapies designed to simplify delivery and improve mobility

[ Go to Respiratory Care ][80]

### Our Products [ Our Products Go to Our Products ][81]

Enabling clinicians to treat patients more efficiently and effectively across care settings,
including in the office-based practice, inpatient care, outpatient care and at home

[ Go to Our Products ][82]
[Two ladies have a discussion in a coffee shop]

## For Patients

You are our passion. Your stories inspire us to work harder at bringing innovations that can make
your experience easier, speed recovery and enable the best possible quality of life.

[Discover Patient Stories][83]

### More For Patients

### General Healthcare [ General Healthcare Go to General Healthcare ][84]

Whether you are receiving care in the hospital, at your doctor’s office or at home, we are here to
support every step of your journey.

[ Go to General Healthcare ][85]

### Nutritional Care [ Nutritional Care Go to Nutritional Care ][86]

When medical conditions prevent you from adequately feeding yourself, we provide clinical nutrition
options to help you regain your nutritional status.

[ Go to Nutritional Care ][87]

### Respiratory Care [ Respiratory Care Go to Respiratory Care ][88]

We are committed to helping you with innovative products that deliver effective, proven respiratory
therapy in the hospital and at home.

[ Go to Respiratory Care ][89]

## Bringing our Purpose to Life

Our mission to save and sustain lives is reflected in our business priorities and our commitment to
be an agent of change at a global level. This means doing what is right for our planet, our patients
and customers, our teams and our communities. We put this commitment into action through high-impact
philanthropy, diversity, equity and inclusion, nurturing partnerships with the healthcare community
and striving for the highest standards of corporate responsibility.

### Our Leadership

Our forward-looking leadership team is a driving force in ensuring we meet our commitments – every
day and everywhere.

[Learn More About Our Leadership][90]

### Our Corporate Responsibility

For nearly a century, we have made a meaningful difference in global healthcare while creating
lasting value for the communities we serve.

[Learn More About Our Corporate Responsibility][91]

### Careers

This is where an inclusive community of diverse individuals is driven to go beyond what is, to what
is possible in healthcare.

[Learn More About Careers at Baxter][92]

### Our History

For more than 90 years, we’ve been focused on our commitment to save and sustain lives with
innovations that elevate patient care, improve outcomes and drive healthcare transformation.

[Learn More About Our History][93]

### NFPA 99 (2026 Edition): Tighter Category 1 Verification Intervals, New Wet-Location
### Documentation

NFPA 99, Health Care Facilities Code, is the backbone document behind how hospitals classify and
maintain medical gas and vacuum systems, electrical distribution, and other risk-based building
systems. Its Category 1 through Category 4 framework ties the rigor of testing and maintenance to
the clinical consequence of failure — a Category 1 system is one whose failure is likely to cause
major injury or death, which is why piped medical gas and isolated power in wet procedure locations
receive the most scrutiny.

Whenever a new edition tightens verification intervals or adds documentation requirements, the real
work lands on hospital electricians, facilities engineers, and biomeds who have to translate code
language into concrete preventive-maintenance tasks and CMMS records. For piped gas systems that
means confirming source alarms, zone valves, and outlet performance on schedule; for isolated power
panels in wet procedure locations it means line isolation monitor (LIM) testing and a clear
accountability trail showing who verified each panel and when.

The practical takeaway is to reconcile your PM program against the exact edition your Authority
Having Jurisdiction has adopted, since CMS and accreditors survey to a specific adopted edition
rather than to the newest one automatically. Confirm the applicable edition, update task frequencies
and checklists accordingly, and keep completed test records retrievable — that documentation is what
a surveyor will actually ask to see.

Sources: [NFPA 99][27]; [CMS][28]; [The Joint Commission][29]

May 14, 20265 min read
[ [biomedrx.com article image] ][30]
Field Notes

### Dispatch: Why That Crash-Cart Defibrillator Was Failing Self-Test Every Other Tuesday

Three Westside hospitals, three identical crash-cart defibrillators, one maddeningly consistent
failure pattern: a self-test fault that appeared roughly every other Tuesday. Our first instinct was
the same as everyone's — the battery pack. Defibrillator batteries are a genuine reliability
concern, and manufacturers and safety bodies emphasize that a unit only helps in a code if its
automated self-test is passing and its battery is charged. But swapping packs didn't stop the
faults, so we widened the investigation.

The breakthrough came from correlating the failure timestamps with something outside the device
entirely: the environmental-services floor-care schedule. On those Tuesday nights the units were
being rolled to the same alcove near a housekeeping closet, exposed to temperature and humidity
swings and, in one case, left plugged into a receptacle that shared a circuit that cycled. The
self-test wasn't lying — it was reporting a real environmental stress the device kept encountering
on a weekly cadence.

The fix was procedural rather than technical: standardize where crash carts are staged, keep
defibrillators within their rated operating environment, and verify each unit's self-test indicator
on every shift check. It is a reminder that not every recurring biomedical failure is a component
defect — sometimes the equipment is fine and the workflow around it is the fault, which is exactly
why incident investigation and manufacturer maintenance guidance both stress looking at use
environment, not just the box.

Sources: [FDA External Defibrillators][31]; [ECRI][32]

## 2026 Industry Update

Where the code stands now, and what health-technology management teams should be preparing for next.

### NFPA 99 (2024) is the enforced edition

As of 2026, the 2024 edition of NFPA 99, Health Care Facilities Code, remains the current edition
and the FDA-recognized consensus standard for health care facilities and appliances — covering
installation, inspection, maintenance, and testing.

### The 2027 edition is in development

The 2027 edition of NFPA 99 is now in development, with proposals under review that add a dedicated
cybersecurity chapter and expanded vendor and contractor security-management requirements.

### What HTM teams should do now

Keep equipment testing and isolated power documentation aligned to the enforced 2024 edition while
preparing for the cybersecurity-focused 2027 changes.

### FDA + CMS RAPID Pathway: What Biomed Departments Should Expect From Faster Breakthrough-Device
### Coverage

For years the gap between FDA market authorization and a Medicare national or local coverage
determination has meant that a device could be legally marketed long before hospitals had a reliable
reimbursement path for it. Efforts to close that gap build directly on the FDA's Breakthrough
Devices Program and on CMS coverage frameworks such as Transitional Coverage for Emerging
Technologies (TCET), both of which are aimed at moving designated devices through review and
coverage decisions on a more predictable, parallel timeline rather than the traditional sequential
one.

For a Healthcare Technology Management (HTM) department, faster coverage does not simply mean
equipment arrives sooner — it compresses the window you have to complete incoming inspection, safety
and electrical testing, network and cybersecurity vetting, and integration into the CMMS before the
device is in clinical use. Departments should expect tighter on-boarding cycles, more emphasis on
coverage-with-evidence-development style data capture, and closer coordination with supply chain,
clinical engineering, and revenue-cycle teams so that a device authorized under a breakthrough
designation is fully commissioned and documented before its first billed procedure.

Practically, this is a documentation and readiness story. Surveyors from The Joint Commission and
CMS continue to expect that every device in service has a complete equipment history, a documented
risk-based maintenance strategy, and evidence of staff training. Build your acceptance-testing
checklist and your alternative-equipment-maintenance justification now, so that a newly covered
breakthrough device does not enter the patient-care environment ahead of the records that prove it
is safe and properly maintained.

Faster device coverage lands on top of a shifting accreditation floor. On June 30, 2025 The Joint
Commission announced Accreditation 360, the largest rewrite of its hospital standards in the
program’s history, consolidating the former Environment of Care and Life Safety chapters into a
single Physical Environment chapter that takes effect in 2026 and shifts emphasis from paperwork
volume toward the demonstrated condition of equipment. For biomed departments onboarding newly
covered breakthrough devices, that means clean incoming inspections, documented preventive
maintenance on 100% of the inventory, and service records that survive a leaner but sharper survey.
We build our programs to that bar. See [The Joint Commission][21] and [CMS][22].

Sources: [FDA Breakthrough Devices Program][23]; [CMS TCET][24]; [The Joint Commission][25]

### NFPA 99 (2026 Edition): Tighter Category 1 Verification Intervals, New Wet-Location
### Documentation

NFPA 99, Health Care Facilities Code, is the backbone document behind how hospitals classify and
maintain medical gas and vacuum systems, electrical distribution, and other risk-based building
systems. Its Category 1 through Category 4 framework ties the rigor of testing and maintenance to
the clinical consequence of failure — a Category 1 system is one whose failure is likely to cause
major injury or death, which is why piped medical gas and isolated power in wet procedure locations
receive the most scrutiny.

Whenever a new edition tightens verification intervals or adds documentation requirements, the real
work lands on hospital electricians, facilities engineers, and biomeds who have to translate code
language into concrete preventive-maintenance tasks and CMMS records. For piped gas systems that
means confirming source alarms, zone valves, and outlet performance on schedule; for isolated power
panels in wet procedure locations it means line isolation monitor (LIM) testing and a clear
accountability trail showing who verified each panel and when.

The practical takeaway is to reconcile your PM program against the exact edition your Authority
Having Jurisdiction has adopted, since CMS and accreditors survey to a specific adopted edition
rather than to the newest one automatically. Confirm the applicable edition, update task frequencies
and checklists accordingly, and keep completed test records retrievable — that documentation is what
a surveyor will actually ask to see.

Sources: [NFPA 99][27]; [CMS][28]; [The Joint Commission][29]

### Dispatch: Why That Crash-Cart Defibrillator Was Failing Self-Test Every Other Tuesday

Three Westside hospitals, three identical crash-cart defibrillators, one maddeningly consistent
failure pattern: a self-test fault that appeared roughly every other Tuesday. Our first instinct was
the same as everyone's — the battery pack. Defibrillator batteries are a genuine reliability
concern, and manufacturers and safety bodies emphasize that a unit only helps in a code if its
automated self-test is passing and its battery is charged. But swapping packs didn't stop the
faults, so we widened the investigation.

The breakthrough came from correlating the failure timestamps with something outside the device
entirely: the environmental-services floor-care schedule. On those Tuesday nights the units were
being rolled to the same alcove near a housekeeping closet, exposed to temperature and humidity
swings and, in one case, left plugged into a receptacle that shared a circuit that cycled. The
self-test wasn't lying — it was reporting a real environmental stress the device kept encountering
on a weekly cadence.

The fix was procedural rather than technical: standardize where crash carts are staged, keep
defibrillators within their rated operating environment, and verify each unit's self-test indicator
on every shift check. It is a reminder that not every recurring biomedical failure is a component
defect — sometimes the equipment is fine and the workflow around it is the fault, which is exactly
why incident investigation and manufacturer maintenance guidance both stress looking at use
environment, not just the box.

Sources: [FDA External Defibrillators][31]; [ECRI][32]

cybersecurity chapter and expanded vendor and contractor security-management requirements.

[

### Diabetic foot bag

][36]

### All products

[
Diabetic foot bag
Diabetes foot bag is a structural treatment device specially designed for diabetes patients.
Diabetes foot bag can help prevent and control the foot depression, anti infection, muscle spasm
relaxation and rigidity of diabetes patients. Diabetes foot bags are usually made of medical guide
wire locks, which can provide micro range and high-precision positioning, greatly improving the
symptoms of patients.
][37]
[[Sampling bottle]][38]
[

### Sampling bottle

][39]

### All products

[
Sampling bottle
A medical sampling bottle is a container used to collect and store various medical samples, such as
blood, urine, and body fluids. Medical sampling bottle is usually made of insoluble glass or
plastic, which can avoid pollution and provide a high level of bacterial protection. There is often
a filling indicator line on the medical sampling bottle to help doctors control the amount of
secretion sample recovered, thereby reducing the risk of contamination.
][40]
[[Torque device]][41]
[

### Torque device

][42]

### All products

[
Torque device
Medical torque device is a special type of guide wire lock, which has characteristics such as
corrosion resistance, low wear resistance, good adaptability to harsh environments, and providing
micro range and high-precision positioning. Medical torque device is very suitable for the medical
industry as it can help healthcare professionals more accurately locate devices or device pieces,
thereby helping patients achieve the best treatment results.
][43]
[[Sinus balloon]][44]
[

### Sinus balloon

][45]

### All products

[
Sinus balloon
The sinus balloon refers to the lifting of the sinus like balloon in the superior frontal sinus of
the heart. The greatest power of this technology lies in creating a perfectly shaped balloon in the
upper frontal sinus cavity to make cardiac action more effective. Sinus balloon can help improve the
condition of irregular heart rate, too fast or too slow heartbeat, thereby shortening the systolic
period of the heart, increasing the reliability of the heartbeat, and reducing the occurrence of
arrhythmia. The main function of the sinus balloon is to control the force of ventricular
contraction and changes in arterial catheter pressure during cardiopulmonary bypass, thereby
regulating blood flow and maintaining rhythmic contraction of the heart and blood circulation.
][46]
[[Inflation device]][47]

][48]

Inflation device
Inflation Device is a kind of device which is used in PCI operation for pressurizing on the balloon
dilation catheter to make the balloon expand so as to realize the goal of expanding the blood vessel
or retaining a stent inside the blood vessel.
][49]

### Sampling bottle

][39]

### All products

[
Sampling bottle
A medical sampling bottle is a container used to collect and store various medical samples, such as
blood, urine, and body fluids. Medical sampling bottle is usually made of insoluble glass or
plastic, which can avoid pollution and provide a high level of bacterial protection. There is often
a filling indicator line on the medical sampling bottle to help doctors control the amount of
secretion sample recovered, thereby reducing the risk of contamination.
][40]
[[Torque device]][41]
[

### Torque device

][42]

### All products

[
Torque device
Medical torque device is a special type of guide wire lock, which has characteristics such as
corrosion resistance, low wear resistance, good adaptability to harsh environments, and providing
micro range and high-precision positioning. Medical torque device is very suitable for the medical
industry as it can help healthcare professionals more accurately locate devices or device pieces,
thereby helping patients achieve the best treatment results.
][43]
[[Sinus balloon]][44]
[

### Sinus balloon

][45]

### All products

[
Sinus balloon
The sinus balloon refers to the lifting of the sinus like balloon in the superior frontal sinus of
the heart. The greatest power of this technology lies in creating a perfectly shaped balloon in the
upper frontal sinus cavity to make cardiac action more effective. Sinus balloon can help improve the
condition of irregular heart rate, too fast or too slow heartbeat, thereby shortening the systolic
period of the heart, increasing the reliability of the heartbeat, and reducing the occurrence of
arrhythmia. The main function of the sinus balloon is to control the force of ventricular
contraction and changes in arterial catheter pressure during cardiopulmonary bypass, thereby
regulating blood flow and maintaining rhythmic contraction of the heart and blood circulation.
][46]

# See what your competitors
# will do next.

While others chase press releases and earnings calls, we capture real intelligence from the data
trails companies leave behind unknowingly — whether competitors, acquisition targets, potential
partners, or emerging disruptors.

Book a Demo
[Watch the Walkthrough][7]
[From digital exhaust to predictions]

## Trusted by teams at

[Intuit][S2A][Eleventh Hour Group][Abridge]
The Problem

## Why traditional intelligence falls short
* Curated narrativePress releases, earnings calls, official announcements — that's the story
  companies want you to see. By the time something is announced, it's too late to respond
  strategically. You're reacting, not planning.
* Commoditized sourcesTraditional market intelligence pulls from the same obvious sources everyone
  else uses. If you're reading it, so are your competitors.
* Data without contextTraditional tools bombard you with notifications — a job posting here, a doc
  update there. You spend hours trying to figure out what matters. You have alerts, not answers.

How it works

## From digital exhaust to predictions

Each step compresses the input. Thousands of raw signals collapse into a handful of patterns, then
into a single forecast you can act on.
* Digital exhaust
  LinkedIn activity
  Job descriptions
  API documentation
  Web & copy changes
  Reddit threads
  + 19 more source types
  CaptureWe monitor the unintentional data trails companies leave behind — job descriptions
  revealing technical debt, API documentation exposing new features, employee posts leaking project
  updates and more. Intelligence they never meant to share.
  Signals
  Hiring
  Field sales push
  12 AE roles, 3 metros
  Product
  New API surface
  Endpoints + docs added
  SynthesizeA single job post or pricing page tweak is noise. Hundreds, woven together, become
  patterns. We connect signals across sources — hiring spikes, doc changes, ad shifts, partnership
  chatter — to surface the combinations that actually mean something.
  Predictions
  Forecast
  Mid-market
  enterprise launch
  Hiring, product, and brand signals align one direction.
  Within 60 days
  High confidence
  PredictFrom the patterns, we forecast what's coming next — product launches, market entries,
  acquisitions, organizational pivots — each with a time horizon and confidence score. You see the
  move before it's made, not after the press release.
Testimonials

  "A competitor quietly sunsetted a feature — no announcement, no changelog, no blog post. The only

The Problem

## Why traditional intelligence falls short
* Curated narrativePress releases, earnings calls, official announcements — that's the story
  companies want you to see. By the time something is announced, it's too late to respond
  strategically. You're reacting, not planning.
* Commoditized sourcesTraditional market intelligence pulls from the same obvious sources everyone
  else uses. If you're reading it, so are your competitors.
* Data without contextTraditional tools bombard you with notifications — a job posting here, a doc
  update there. You spend hours trying to figure out what matters. You have alerts, not answers.

How it works

## Frequently Asked Questions

[

View All FAQ's

][25]

What is Henry?

Henry is a telehealth service that makes it easy and affordable to get the medical care you need. We
help people manage weight loss, perimenopause and testosterone hormone therapies, and erectile
dysfunction, as well as other conditions. It’s easy to get started—just answer a few questions about
your health and lifestyle goals, and we’ll connect you with an expert provider. If medically
approved, you’ll get your prescribed medication by mail within a week. There’s no insurance
required. Just a simple monthly bill with your provider visits, medication and supplies, and ongoing
care included.

How does Henry work?

Henry makes it easy to get the personalized care you need in just a few steps. Answer a few
questions about your health and goals. A licensed healthcare provider will review your information
and recommend treatment if necessary. If prescribed, you’ll get your medication by mail within a few
days. There’s no insurance stress or surprise bills. Just one monthly payment that includes your
provider visit, medication and supplies, and ongoing care.

Who can use Henry?

Henry is open to all adults! To use Henry, you must: Be 18 years or older. Have a demonstrated
medical need for treatment. Live or have an address in one of the states we support.

How do I see a provider?

Click any “Get Started” button and answer a few questions about your health and lifestyle goals.
You’ll then be able to schedule a provider visit face-to-face with a video call, or depending on
your home state, choose an independent provider review without a video call. You and your provider
will be able to exchange messages through our secure patient portal.

Does Henry require a long-term contract?

No long-term contracts! Henry offers convenient monthly plans, as well as longer term plans for
certain treatments. You can easily cancel any time.

How soon will I receive my medication?

Most people receive their medication within 8-10 business days after they speak to their provider.
Just a heads up, people in California may experience longer fulfillment times because of additional
compound testing requirements.

What if I need to cancel?

You can cancel at any time in your account page of the patient portal, by contacting our support
team at ask@henrymeds.com, or by calling 909-787-2342. If you’re on a multi-month plan, you may be
required to pay out the rest of your balance unless you’re unable to continue for medical-related
reasons as determined by a healthcare provider.

What is compounded medication?

Compounded medication is prescription medicine from a licensed provider that’s custom-made by a
licensed pharmacist. Instead of a one-size-fits-all drug from big manufacturers, the pharmacist will
mix or adjust ingredients in compounded medication to tailor to your specific needs. Because these
medications are customized, they’re not FDA-approved in the same way as commercial drugs, but they
do use FDA-approved ingredients.

Do I need insurance?

No, you don’t need insurance! Henry makes it easy to get the care you need without having to deal
with insurance claims. Your provider visits, medication and supplies, shipping, and ongoing care are
all included in your plan price—without any hidden or surprise fees.

*If medically eligible

## Frequently Asked Questions

[

View All FAQ's

][25]

What is Henry?

Henry is a telehealth service that makes it easy and affordable to get the medical care you need. We
help people manage weight loss, perimenopause and testosterone hormone therapies, and erectile
dysfunction, as well as other conditions. It’s easy to get started—just answer a few questions about
your health and lifestyle goals, and we’ll connect you with an expert provider. If medically
approved, you’ll get your prescribed medication by mail within a week. There’s no insurance
required. Just a simple monthly bill with your provider visits, medication and supplies, and ongoing
care included.

How does Henry work?

Henry makes it easy to get the personalized care you need in just a few steps. Answer a few
questions about your health and goals. A licensed healthcare provider will review your information
and recommend treatment if necessary. If prescribed, you’ll get your medication by mail within a few
days. There’s no insurance stress or surprise bills. Just one monthly payment that includes your
provider visit, medication and supplies, and ongoing care.

Who can use Henry?

Henry is open to all adults! To use Henry, you must: Be 18 years or older. Have a demonstrated
medical need for treatment. Live or have an address in one of the states we support.

How do I see a provider?

Click any “Get Started” button and answer a few questions about your health and lifestyle goals.
You’ll then be able to schedule a provider visit face-to-face with a video call, or depending on
your home state, choose an independent provider review without a video call. You and your provider
will be able to exchange messages through our secure patient portal.

Does Henry require a long-term contract?

No long-term contracts! Henry offers convenient monthly plans, as well as longer term plans for
certain treatments. You can easily cancel any time.

How soon will I receive my medication?

Most people receive their medication within 8-10 business days after they speak to their provider.
Just a heads up, people in California may experience longer fulfillment times because of additional
compound testing requirements.

What if I need to cancel?

You can cancel at any time in your account page of the patient portal, by contacting our support
team at ask@henrymeds.com, or by calling 909-787-2342. If you’re on a multi-month plan, you may be
required to pay out the rest of your balance unless you’re unable to continue for medical-related
reasons as determined by a healthcare provider.

What is compounded medication?

Compounded medication is prescription medicine from a licensed provider that’s custom-made by a
licensed pharmacist. Instead of a one-size-fits-all drug from big manufacturers, the pharmacist will
mix or adjust ingredients in compounded medication to tailor to your specific needs. Because these
medications are customized, they’re not FDA-approved in the same way as commercial drugs, but they
do use FDA-approved ingredients.

Do I need insurance?

No, you don’t need insurance! Henry makes it easy to get the care you need without having to deal
with insurance claims. Your provider visits, medication and supplies, shipping, and ongoing care are
all included in your plan price—without any hidden or surprise fees.

*If medically eligible

### Institutes & Departments

Connect with expert teams across our [Institutes and Departments][91] to collaborate on patient care

Whether you’re just graduating from nursing school or have years of experience, you can build an
exceptional career in [nursing at Cleveland Clinic][92].

### Careers

As one of the nation’s — and the world’s — leading academic medical centers, you can grow in a
setting where you’ll make a difference. [Find your career][93] at Cleveland Clinic.

### Refer a Patient

We welcome the opportunity to partner with you in caring for your patients. Our dedicated [Referring
Physician team][94] is available from 7 a.m. to 7 p.m. EST every day for you and your patients.

A [site for physicians and healthcare professionals][95] from Cleveland Clinic. Discover the latest
research insights, innovations and treatment trends.

We’re dedicated to training the next generation of healthcare professionals. Explore the [training
and education programs][96] we offer worldwide.

translational and clinical research][97].

# Enjoy the Best Views in Austin from Mount Bonnell

#### From Mount Bonnell, the high point Austin TX, you have awesome views on Austin, the Colorado
#### River and the Texas Hill Country

[ Visit Mount Bonnell ][23]
 

### What to Do at Mount Bonnell

At the peak you will find Covert Park, an Austin view point with 360-degree views that include the
city skyline and Lake Austin. This free Austin Mount Bonnell experience attracts locals and tourists
from around the world and offers a variety of activities. There are plenty of nearby Lake Austin
hotels and luxury hotels in Austin to provide you with a memorable stay.

[ 10 Reasons to Visit Austin Mt Bonnell ][24]

## About Mount Bonnell

Bonnell Mountain is a great landmark and one of the most visited sites and tourist attractions in
Austin. The limestone height stands at 775 ft above sea level and is considered to be the highest
point within Austin City Limits. It has been a popular sightseeing destination since the mid-19th
century and continues to attract tourists and locals for mountain biking, hiking, and more on the
Mount Bonnel hiking trail. In fact, it’s a favorite for mountain bikers and a Mount Bonell hike is
on the bucket list of many tourists. Mount Bonnell also known as Covert Park belongs, next to other
parks such as Mueller Lake Park and Zilker Park, to the best parks in Austin.

Visit Mt. Bonnell Austin TX and Covert Park at Mount Bonnell trails and enjoy the beauty of the
Austin skyline. If you want to learn more, you can also buy one of many topographic maps with
elevation data and Austin TX Mount Bonnell directions. So, when tourists arrive and ask: Are there
mountains in Austin, Texas? You can tell them to get ready for an exciting walk on the Mt Bonell
stairs to the top. While you’re visiting Bonnell Austin, don’t forget to take in [Circuit of
Americas][25] Austin TX, the country’s premier destination for phenomenal motorsports and live
entertainment. If you’re a diehard sports fan, check out 104.9 The Horn Austin, it’s a local Austin
radio station with station broadcasts in sports format and is the flagship station of the Texas
Longhorns. If My Bonnell has given you an appetite for heights take a trip out to Texas Hill Country
to see the rural countryside of Central Texas with its rugged hills and native vegetation.

If you’re looking for accommodation, you’ll be spoilt for choice, from family hotels to five star
hotels in Austin. [Hotel Saint Cecilia][26] in Austin and [The Loren at Lady Bird Lake][27] both
offer upscale accommodations where you can recover after sightseeing in two of the best Austin
luxury hotels.

[ About Mount Bonnell ][28]

## Mount Bonnell Gallery

Check out our gallery page with beautiful photos of Mount Bonn that other visitors have shared. Why
not share your own favorite pic featuring Mount Bonnell for the chance to win a cool t-shirt?

# Enjoy the Best Views in Austin from Mount Bonnell

#### From Mount Bonnell, the high point Austin TX, you have awesome views on Austin, the Colorado
#### River and the Texas Hill Country

[ Visit Mount Bonnell ][23]
 

### What to Do at Mount Bonnell

At the peak you will find Covert Park, an Austin view point with 360-degree views that include the
city skyline and Lake Austin. This free Austin Mount Bonnell experience attracts locals and tourists
from around the world and offers a variety of activities. There are plenty of nearby Lake Austin
hotels and luxury hotels in Austin to provide you with a memorable stay.

[ 10 Reasons to Visit Austin Mt Bonnell ][24]

## About Mount Bonnell

Bonnell Mountain is a great landmark and one of the most visited sites and tourist attractions in
Austin. The limestone height stands at 775 ft above sea level and is considered to be the highest
point within Austin City Limits. It has been a popular sightseeing destination since the mid-19th
century and continues to attract tourists and locals for mountain biking, hiking, and more on the
Mount Bonnel hiking trail. In fact, it’s a favorite for mountain bikers and a Mount Bonell hike is
on the bucket list of many tourists. Mount Bonnell also known as Covert Park belongs, next to other
parks such as Mueller Lake Park and Zilker Park, to the best parks in Austin.

Visit Mt. Bonnell Austin TX and Covert Park at Mount Bonnell trails and enjoy the beauty of the
Austin skyline. If you want to learn more, you can also buy one of many topographic maps with
elevation data and Austin TX Mount Bonnell directions. So, when tourists arrive and ask: Are there
mountains in Austin, Texas? You can tell them to get ready for an exciting walk on the Mt Bonell
stairs to the top. While you’re visiting Bonnell Austin, don’t forget to take in [Circuit of
Americas][25] Austin TX, the country’s premier destination for phenomenal motorsports and live
entertainment. If you’re a diehard sports fan, check out 104.9 The Horn Austin, it’s a local Austin
radio station with station broadcasts in sports format and is the flagship station of the Texas
Longhorns. If My Bonnell has given you an appetite for heights take a trip out to Texas Hill Country
to see the rural countryside of Central Texas with its rugged hills and native vegetation.

If you’re looking for accommodation, you’ll be spoilt for choice, from family hotels to five star
hotels in Austin. [Hotel Saint Cecilia][26] in Austin and [The Loren at Lady Bird Lake][27] both
offer upscale accommodations where you can recover after sightseeing in two of the best Austin
luxury hotels.

[ About Mount Bonnell ][28]

### Solutions for the challenges you face

We’re inspired by positive patient outcomes. Over more than 80 years we’ve delivered
industry-leading technology, expert service, and specialized education to make a world of difference
in the lives of care providers and their patients.

[Neuro Solutions][103]
[Service & Support][104]

We put clinicians first in the consideration and development of each solution we provide. We deliver
innovative and trusted solutions to screen, diagnose, and treat disorders affecting the brain and
neural pathways.

[Neuro Products][106]

We are dedicated to providing unparalleled service to ensure a seamless experience, helping our
partners to deliver the highest standard of care and achieve the best possible patient outcomes.

[Service & Support][107]

We are committed to helping healthcare providers worldwide feel confident they can achieve the best
possible results. Natus Academies provide expert knowledge, clinical expertise and advanced
education – whatever your role, wherever you work.

# Robot Simulation Software

RoboDK is a complete solution to simulate and program robot arms offline for robot manufacturing and
automation.

[ Download Trial ][47]

## Extensive Robot Library

Up-to-date library of robot arms, manufacturing applications and sample industrial automation
projects.

[Library][48]

## CAD/CAM Software

Extensive integration options with CAD/CAM software, making it easier to simulate and program robots
to automate manufacturing.

[Success Stories][49]

## Marketplace

Plenty of Add-ins and extensions at your disposal to enhance and customize RoboDK software.

[Add-in Marketplace][50]

## Easy to Use

RoboDK's intuitive interface requires no programming skills to simulate robot arms and the
step-by-step guide simplifies the process of generating robot programs.

[ Getting Started Guide][51]

## Software Features

RoboDK offers all the features required create your Digital Twin quickly and accurately.

[RoboDK robot]
* [
  
  ### Robot Simulation & Offline Programming
  
  Create robot simulations and robot programs for any robot arm in minutes. You can easily and
  accurately simulate your robot arms with RoboDK software.
  
  ][52]
* [
  
  ### Robot Machining
  
  Use robots for manufacturing applications such as robot machining or 3D printing. Simulate and
  convert 5-axis CNC programs such as G-Code or APT-CLS for your robot controller.
  
  ][53]
* [
  
  ### Robot Programs
  
  Easily generate robot programs offline for any robot controller. You don't need to learn
  vendor-specific programming anymore.
  
  ][54]
* [
  
  ### Support 3D Models
  
  Import 3D models in formats such as STL, STEP, and IGES, and accurately create your Digital Twin.
  
  ][55]
* [
  
  ### Post Processors
  
  RoboDK Post Processors include support for many robot controllers, including ABB RAPID (mod/prg),
  Fanuc (LS/TP), KUKA KRC (SRC), Motoman Inform (JBI), Universal Robots (URP/script) and much more!
  
  ][56]
* [
  
  ### External Axes
  
  Easily integrate and simulate robots with external axes to extend the reachability of your robot.
  
  ][57]
* [
  
  ### Robot Accuracy
  
  Calibrate your robot arm to improve accuracy up to 0.100 mm. RoboDK software combines all the
  simulation and calibration features in one solution.
  
  ][58]
* [
  
  ### Avoid Singularities and Collisions
  
  Easily create your Digital Twin offline and prevent the robot from going through singularities,
  axis limits and collisions.
  
  ][59]
* [
  
  ### RoboDK API
  
  Create robot programs using modern programming languages such as Python, C# or C++. Software
  developers can easily customize the interface.
  
  ][60]

## Supported Robot Brands

RoboDK supports over 80 different robot manufacturers, providing access to an extensive robot
library.

[ Robot Library][61]
[ 15 more ][62]

## Robot Applications

Use robot arms for any manufacturing application. You can find plenty of examples in our
documentation.

# Robot Simulation Software

RoboDK is a complete solution to simulate and program robot arms offline for robot manufacturing and
automation.

[ Download Trial ][47]

## Extensive Robot Library

Up-to-date library of robot arms, manufacturing applications and sample industrial automation
projects.

[Library][48]

## CAD/CAM Software

Extensive integration options with CAD/CAM software, making it easier to simulate and program robots
to automate manufacturing.

[Success Stories][49]

## Marketplace

Plenty of Add-ins and extensions at your disposal to enhance and customize RoboDK software.

[Add-in Marketplace][50]

## Easy to Use

RoboDK's intuitive interface requires no programming skills to simulate robot arms and the
step-by-step guide simplifies the process of generating robot programs.

[ Getting Started Guide][51]

## Software Features

RoboDK offers all the features required create your Digital Twin quickly and accurately.

[RoboDK robot]
* [
  
  ### Robot Simulation & Offline Programming
  
  Create robot simulations and robot programs for any robot arm in minutes. You can easily and
  accurately simulate your robot arms with RoboDK software.
  
  ][52]
* [
  
  ### Robot Machining
  
  Use robots for manufacturing applications such as robot machining or 3D printing. Simulate and
  convert 5-axis CNC programs such as G-Code or APT-CLS for your robot controller.
  
  ][53]
* [
  
  ### Robot Programs
  
  Easily generate robot programs offline for any robot controller. You don't need to learn
  vendor-specific programming anymore.
  
  ][54]
* [
  
  ### Support 3D Models
  
  Import 3D models in formats such as STL, STEP, and IGES, and accurately create your Digital Twin.
  
  ][55]
* [
  
  ### Post Processors
  
  RoboDK Post Processors include support for many robot controllers, including ABB RAPID (mod/prg),
  Fanuc (LS/TP), KUKA KRC (SRC), Motoman Inform (JBI), Universal Robots (URP/script) and much more!
  
  ][56]
* [
  
  ### External Axes
  
  Easily integrate and simulate robots with external axes to extend the reachability of your robot.
  
  ][57]
* [
  
  ### Robot Accuracy
  
  Calibrate your robot arm to improve accuracy up to 0.100 mm. RoboDK software combines all the
  simulation and calibration features in one solution.
  
  ][58]
* [
  
  ### Avoid Singularities and Collisions
  
  Easily create your Digital Twin offline and prevent the robot from going through singularities,
  axis limits and collisions.
  
  ][59]
* [
  
  ### RoboDK API
  
  Create robot programs using modern programming languages such as Python, C# or C++. Software
  developers can easily customize the interface.
  
  ][60]

## Supported Robot Brands

RoboDK supports over 80 different robot manufacturers, providing access to an extensive robot
library.

[ Robot Library][61]
[ 15 more ][62]

## Robot Applications

Use robot arms for any manufacturing application. You can find plenty of examples in our
documentation.

[ Pricing Options ][63]

Fast and efficient robot welding

[ Welding application ][64]

Advanced machining with high accuracy

[ Machining application ][65]

[ Dispensing application ][66]

[ Polishing application ][67]
[Cutting logo]

Cutting

Precise cutting with accurate programming

[ Cutting application ][68]
[Palettizing logo]

Palletizing

[ Palletizing application ][69]

# Treaton — Your Trusted Partner in Medical Equipment for Anesthesiology and Intensive Care

Treaton (Triton Electronic Systems Ltd.) is a leading Russian manufacturer specializing in the
development, production, and full-service support of high-tech medical equipment for anesthesiology,
intensive care units (ICU), resuscitation, and emergency medicine. With more than 35 years of
experience, we deliver reliable, innovative, and safe solutions that medical professionals trust
every day.

Our equipment is successfully used by leading medical institutions, including the Ministry of
Health, Ministry of Internal Affairs, Ministry of Defense, and Ministry of Emergency Situations of
the Russian Federation, as well as by partners in over 40 countries worldwide.

## Comprehensive Range of Medical Equipment

### Mechanical Ventilators and Respiratory Support Systems

We manufacture a wide range of modern ventilators designed for intensive care, transport, and
emergency situations. Our devices support both invasive and non-invasive ventilation for adult,
pediatric, and neonatal patients.

#### ZisLine MV350 — Advanced ICU Ventilator

High-performance intensive care ventilator with advanced ventilation modes and excellent monitoring
capabilities.

#### ZisLine T100 — Portable Transport Ventilator

Compact and reliable transport ventilator ideal for ambulances, intra-hospital transport, and
emergency medical services.

### Patient Monitoring Systems

Treaton offers high-precision patient monitors and central monitoring stations that provide
real-time monitoring of vital signs in operating rooms and intensive care units.

### OEM Modules and Components

We develop and supply advanced OEM solutions for medical device manufacturers, including:

#### Mainstream and Sidestream Gas Analysis Modules

High-accuracy CO₂, O₂, and anesthetic gas monitoring sensors for integration into anesthesia
machines and ventilators.

#### Depth of Anesthesia and Sedation Monitoring Modules

Advanced Brain Activity Index (AI) monitoring technology for safe and effective procedural sedation
and general anesthesia.

## Why Medical Institutions Choose Treaton

### Proven Quality and International Certification

All Treaton equipment undergoes strict quality control and meets international standards. Our
products are certified and regularly tested in real clinical conditions.

### Innovation Backed by 35 Years of Experience

#### Advanced Technologies Developed In-House

Our key developments include indirect calorimetry for metabolic assessment and unique non-invasive
hemodynamic monitoring technologies.

#### Continuous Research and Development

We constantly improve our products by implementing the latest achievements in biomedical engineering
and respiratory support.

### Reliable Service and Technical Support

We provide full lifecycle support for our equipment:

#### Warranty and Post-Warranty Maintenance

#### Extended Warranty Programs

#### Professional Training for Biomedical Engineers

#### 24/7 Technical Consultation and Prompt Repair Service

### Professional Team Dedicated to Your Success

Our team consists of experienced engineers, developers, anesthesiologists, and international sales
specialists who work closely with each client to deliver the best technical and commercial
solutions.

## Customized OEM Solutions for Medical Device Manufacturers

Treaton is a reliable OEM partner offering high-precision gas analysis modules, sedation monitoring
systems, and other critical components. We help manufacturers enhance their equipment with
cutting-edge technology while reducing development time and costs.

## Partner with Treaton Today

Contact our team to learn more about our full range of medical ventilators, patient monitors, OEM
modules, and comprehensive service programs. We are ready to provide tailored solutions that
perfectly match the needs of your hospital, clinic, or manufacturing project.

**Treaton — Advanced Medical Technology • Reliable Performance • Professional Support • 35 Years of
Excellence**

# Treaton — Your Trusted Partner in Medical Equipment for Anesthesiology and Intensive Care

Treaton (Triton Electronic Systems Ltd.) is a leading Russian manufacturer specializing in the
development, production, and full-service support of high-tech medical equipment for anesthesiology,
intensive care units (ICU), resuscitation, and emergency medicine. With more than 35 years of
experience, we deliver reliable, innovative, and safe solutions that medical professionals trust
every day.

Our equipment is successfully used by leading medical institutions, including the Ministry of
Health, Ministry of Internal Affairs, Ministry of Defense, and Ministry of Emergency Situations of
the Russian Federation, as well as by partners in over 40 countries worldwide.

## Comprehensive Range of Medical Equipment

### Mechanical Ventilators and Respiratory Support Systems

We manufacture a wide range of modern ventilators designed for intensive care, transport, and
emergency situations. Our devices support both invasive and non-invasive ventilation for adult,
pediatric, and neonatal patients.

#### ZisLine MV350 — Advanced ICU Ventilator

High-performance intensive care ventilator with advanced ventilation modes and excellent monitoring
capabilities.

#### ZisLine T100 — Portable Transport Ventilator

Compact and reliable transport ventilator ideal for ambulances, intra-hospital transport, and
emergency medical services.

### Patient Monitoring Systems

Treaton offers high-precision patient monitors and central monitoring stations that provide
real-time monitoring of vital signs in operating rooms and intensive care units.

### OEM Modules and Components

We develop and supply advanced OEM solutions for medical device manufacturers, including:

#### Mainstream and Sidestream Gas Analysis Modules

High-accuracy CO₂, O₂, and anesthetic gas monitoring sensors for integration into anesthesia
machines and ventilators.

#### Depth of Anesthesia and Sedation Monitoring Modules

Advanced Brain Activity Index (AI) monitoring technology for safe and effective procedural sedation
and general anesthesia.

## Why Medical Institutions Choose Treaton

### Proven Quality and International Certification

All Treaton equipment undergoes strict quality control and meets international standards. Our
products are certified and regularly tested in real clinical conditions.

### Innovation Backed by 35 Years of Experience

#### Advanced Technologies Developed In-House

Our key developments include indirect calorimetry for metabolic assessment and unique non-invasive
hemodynamic monitoring technologies.

#### Continuous Research and Development

We constantly improve our products by implementing the latest achievements in biomedical engineering
and respiratory support.

### Reliable Service and Technical Support

We provide full lifecycle support for our equipment:

#### Warranty and Post-Warranty Maintenance

#### Extended Warranty Programs

#### Professional Training for Biomedical Engineers

#### 24/7 Technical Consultation and Prompt Repair Service

### Professional Team Dedicated to Your Success

Our team consists of experienced engineers, developers, anesthesiologists, and international sales
specialists who work closely with each client to deliver the best technical and commercial
solutions.

## Customized OEM Solutions for Medical Device Manufacturers

Treaton is a reliable OEM partner offering high-precision gas analysis modules, sedation monitoring
systems, and other critical components. We help manufacturers enhance their equipment with
cutting-edge technology while reducing development time and costs.

## Partner with Treaton Today

Contact our team to learn more about our full range of medical ventilators, patient monitors, OEM
modules, and comprehensive service programs. We are ready to provide tailored solutions that
perfectly match the needs of your hospital, clinic, or manufacturing project.

**Treaton — Advanced Medical Technology • Reliable Performance • Professional Support • 35 Years of
Excellence**

# Shaping the decarbonisation of marine and energy


Our everyday lives depend on a steady supply of electricity and goods shipped to us from across the
world.

Yet, marine and energy generate over a third of global greenhouse gases. That’s why we’re shaping
the decarbonisation of marine and energy.

[About us][8]

2050

net-zero target year
for shipping and energy

180

countries with our
energy installations

110,000

vessels sailing worldwide,
one-third using our solutions

3,500

Wärtsilä service professionals
in the field

## Enabling you to cut emissions at sea and on land

We help our customers take a decarbonisation journey that is environmentally sustainable and
financially viable.

[Senayan power plant in Indonesia]
[lightning-icon]
Energy

We help the energy sector accelerate the transition towards a 100% renewable energy future with our
market-leading technologies and power system expertise. Energy providers globally rely on our
flexible engine power plants, energy storage systems, intelligent optimisation technologies, and
lifecycle services. With reliable, affordable, and sustainable power as your goal, our solutions
support you in ramping up and balancing intermittent renewables.

[Wärtsilä in energy][9]
[Gas tanker on open sea]
[marine-icon]
Marine

With Wärtsilä as your partner, your maritime operations can be smarter, cleaner, and more efficient.
One in three of the world’s large vessels already relies on our technologies – power, propulsion and
other solutions – because you value reliability, safety, and performance. And as the industry moves
toward alternative fuels and digital ecosystems, we help you stay ahead with our future-proof
solutions.

[Wärtsilä in marine][10]
[Power plant in the desert]
[Service men at pier]
[Freight vessel in port]

## Interim report for April-June 2026 has been published

In the second quarter of 2026, Wärtsilä’s total order intake increased by 33% to 2,849 MEUR to an
all-time high quarter, contributing to an all-time high order book of 8,976 MEUR. The operating
result increased by 14% to EUR 209 million, representing 13.4% of net sales. Cash flow from
operating activities increased to EUR 497 million.

[Read more][11]

## Global impact. Succeeding together.

From world-first technology launches to performance-based agreements, we innovate to create value
with our customers and partners.

[
Solvang

Onboard carbon capture successfully cuts CO2 emissions by 70% for Solvang’s Clipper Eris carrier

][12][
Aqualectra, Curacao

Installed a new 38.4 MW grid balancing engine power plant in addition to the 25 MW / 45 MWh Energy
Storage System installed earlier.

][13][
GIGA Storage BV

Installed Wärtsilä's 25 MW / 48 MWh energy storage in the Netherlands, improving grid stability and
scaling renewable integration.

][14][
Viking Line

Finnish ferry company Viking Line is a market leader in passenger transport in the northern Baltic
Sea region.

][15][
United Power

United Power manages over 2,137 MW of installed capacity in Bangladesh, of which 1,066 MW is powered
by Wärtsilä engines.

][16][
Clearway Energy

Partnered with Wärtsilä for storage solutions supporting reliable renewable energy in California and
Hawaii.

][17]
[leaf-icon]
Green is not black or white.

While no single solution will carry us through the transition, we already have most of the
technology needed to decarbonise. From engines that run flexibly on low- and zero-carbon fuels to
AI-driven predictive analytics, we are using all tools in the toolbox to help our customers take the
next step on their decarbonisation journey.

## ABOUT US

For over seven decades, Western Enterprises has been a leading provider of reliable and high-quality
products for the control, storage, and transmission of high-pressure gases. Our commitment to
excellence and customer satisfaction has made us the go-to choice for industrial, medical, and
specialty gas markets. Our extensive range of compressed gas systems and components are designed to
meet the most stringent standards, ensuring safe and efficient operations. From regulators and
flowmeters to cylinders and valves, our products are built to last and perform optimally in
demanding environments.
